The divisor is reduced, meets the domain, and has finite-order singular escape \((e^{-m\tau}-1)^2\). The supporting-hypersurface contradiction treats leading degrees below, above, and equal to \(2m\), with a root-of-unity cancellation in the resonant case. The inspected primary theorem then applies directly.
